newsitem.title: USA: AMEX begins trading ZEVEX International.
newsitem.headline: AMEX begins trading ZEVEX International.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Monday it began trading the common stock of ZEVEX International Inc.
Formerly trading on Nasdaq, ZEVEX is currently trading under the symbol ZVX on AMEX.
ZEVEX opened at 11-3/8 on 500 shares, AMEX said.
The exchange said ZEVEX manufactures and sells electronic medical components and privately-labeled systems.
